purpose: Build original reusable Grifon effects for commercial ads, UGC, motion graphics and cinematic edits; assess stronger SFX in the current approved film.
qualityTarget: Convincing material/weight, precise action sync, controlled tails, intelligibility under narration, phone-speaker and mono translation. FilmCrux-equivalent quality is a target requiring listening, not an established result.

reference.observed: The public page separates cinematic sound design from practical Foley/diegetic effects and music.
reference.inspection: Product-page text only. No demo audition or proprietary sample analysis/copying is claimed.

provenance: Pilot files are original local procedural synthesis, with reproducible source and seeds. The existing film retains its already licensed stock contribution; none of those stock samples are included in this standalone pilot library.

production.masters: Stereo 48kHz/24-bit PCM WAV, headroom, clean edges, centered body and mono-compatible upper space.

sceneRules.ugc: Sparse practical Foley and quiet dry punctuation; avoid trailer-scale hits on ordinary actions.
sceneRules.commercial: Movement plus believable contact, selective weight on hero reveals and brand ending.
sceneRules.cinematic: Anticipation, textured weight, deliberate decay and rests; reserve the largest impact for the story peak.
sceneRules.motion-ui: Short tactile feedback and movement; do not sonify every visible animation.

humanAcceptance: At matched listening volume, blind A/B prefers the redesigned film for impact and action fit
Phone speakers retain body without the sub layer
Headphones have no harsh/noisy transient or excessive stereo distraction
No generic click repetition or continuous impact spam
production.limits: Signal checks do not establish premium quality. Real packaging/cloth/latch/product material detail requires original recordings or separately vetted sources. No asset has been integrated into the production app.

sounds.use: Compact hero-product contact with low-mid weight
Rare cinematic peak; include upper harmonics for phones
Energy release and change of pace
Restrained cinematic scale, key-aware if used with music
Soft low-mid bloom and airy reveal tail
Brand contact and short signature decay
Correct product material meeting the actual surface
Sparse count milestone, not every number

research.finding: Optional future text-to-SFX generation supports cinematic/Foley effects and controlled duration. This prototype makes no provider calls.
AI output commercial terms depend on plan and service; a free account is not automatically a commercial license. No such output is in this pilot.
External recordings have individual licenses. Verify each file's provenance and reuse terms before any future library inclusion.
